messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: [itemfit] fix the person parameters
parts:
Yes, just pass the values to the Theta argument. E.g.,

library(mirt)
mod <- mirt(Science, 1)
fs <- fscores(mod, full.scores=TRUE)
itemfit(mod, Theta = fs, X2 = TRUE)

fs2 <- fscores(mod, method = 'ML', full.scores=TRUE)
itemfit(mod, Theta = fs2, X2 = TRUE)
